name: First Contact
intro: Target: relay01, a forgotten office server.
A careless admin left a flag somewhere on this machine.
tutorial: Welcome! You control this computer by typing commands and pressing Enter.
Try it now: type  ls  and press Enter to look around.
Tips: Tab auto-completes names. Drag or double-click text to copy it.
objective: Find the hidden flag on this machine and submit it. Flags look like FLAG{...}.
hints: Not everything on a computer is shown by default. Read 'help' for the ls options.
Hidden files and folders start with a dot. 'ls -a' shows them.
Run 'ls -a', then 'cd .private', then 'cat flag.txt', then submit what you find.

admin.notes.txt:
Remember to rotate the server keys.
Also, I really should clean up my home folder.
